## Summary

Turns the transcript into a live run view and lets a finished run be read back:

- **Permissions** — a run that stops for approval renders a card with the pending request, so the decision is made in the conversation rather than in a side channel.
- **Tool cards** — each tool call shows its input, its result and its status; a result that is not in the run state is read from the tool's own substream the first time the card is opened, keeping progress frames and the final result as separate sections.
- **Run folding** — completed steps fold into a summary row, keeping a long run readable while every step stays one click away.
- **Replay** — a finished turn is reconstructed from the persisted run records (`foldRunRecords`, `replayRun`, `RunReplay`, `placeReplays`), so reopening a session shows the same steps, tool output and permission decisions.
- **Reducer and stream** — permission state, tool traces and replay cursors are folded into the existing run state.

## Stack

Part **2 of 6**. The foundation (#499) is merged, so this branch sits directly on `main` and carries a single commit; the incremental change is the [compare against `main`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/compare/main...ink999107:pr/02-run-stream). The later PRs (#501–#504) build on this branch.

## Summary

Resumes the most recent session when the app starts.

- `resumeSession` in `session-order.ts` returns the most recently updated session, or `undefined` when a session is already open, so the decision is testable on its own.
- `resumeOnBoot` carries the decision out against the first listing: it acts once, skips a failed read (which is not an empty workspace), and opens a resumed Session the same way a clicked one does. The bootstrap effect is only its caller.
- The resumed session's Project is adopted before it opens. The listing spans every Project, so without this the app could show one Project's conversation while filing the next 新增会话 or upload under another.
- Sessions are still ordered by recency, and the list that was already current in the sidebar is the one the app resumes.

515.author: zhaozhaozz
515.body:
Daily research workers stopped before model calls when `ubuntu-latest` moved to Ubuntu 26.04 / CPython 3.14.4: NumPy 2.2.6 and SciPy 1.15.3 have no matching wheels, and the fallback SciPy build fails looking for OpenBLAS. Keep the new Ubuntu and Python, and install supported wheels instead.

Closes #514.

## Changes

- Share the seven benchmark dependency pins between real preparation and offline research regression checks. Update only NumPy to 2.3.5 and SciPy to 1.16.3; retain pandas 2.3.3 and the other existing direct versions.
- Default both benchmark entry points to Python 3.14, with a dedicated `SCIENCE_RESEARCH_PYTHON` override. The PR research check previously inherited the gateway's Python 3.12, which could hide this failure. Product service environments keep their existing interpreters and dependencies.
- Require wheels in both entry points so missing wheels fail during resolution instead of starting native builds.
- Add a Biomni preparation regression that resolves the installed Hub API, supplies local download fixtures, verifies the pinned files and rejects corruption.

[NumPy 2.3.5](https://pypi.org/project/numpy/2.3.5/#files), [SciPy 1.16.3](https://pypi.org/project/scipy/1.16.3/#files) and [pandas 2.3.3](https://pypi.org/project/pandas/2.3.3/#files) publish CPython 3.14 Linux AMD64/ARM64 wheels. These pins satisfy the fixed DRB revision's [dependency lower bounds](https://github.com/Ayanami0730/deep_research_bench/blob/852f4022d1f98fb707222e395405136e8f0e8d52/requirements.txt). The Biomni upstream environment files remain verified provenance inputs, not an installed evaluator environment. Benchmark revisions, scoring and real-case evidence assertions are unchanged.

## Validation

Tested tree committed as `916c190b63635581df14ef43aa7938771a8189b3`.

| Check | Environment | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Old numerical pins with wheel-only installation | Clean Ubuntu 26.04.1 container, system CPython 3.14.4, AMD64 | Expected resolution failure: NumPy 2.2.6 has no usable wheel |
| `bash .ci/prepare-real-research.sh` (DRB branch), `uv pip check`, dependency imports | Same target container; no BLAS development packages or compiler installed | PASS: 21 packages installed without source builds, fixed DRB checkout prepared, no broken requirements |
| `bash .ci/run-research-python.sh unit` | Same target container; generic service test interpreter deliberately set to a nonexistent path | PASS: Biomni 19/19, DRB 16/16; zero skips/failures. Includes numerical clustering/association checks and the fixed upstream RACE/FACT pipeline with mocked model/fetch responses |
| Biomni prepare/verify and DRB evaluate CLI imports (`--help`) | Same target container | PASS: 3/3 |
| `pnpm ci:selftest` | Host Ubuntu 24.04 | PASS: 83/83, zero skips/failures |
| `pnpm ci:l1` | Host Ubuntu 24.04 | PASS: planned 4, executed 4, passed 4; zero skips/failures |
| Shell syntax and `git diff --check` | Host | PASS |

## GitHub CI

[PR run 40060251093](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/40060251093) completed successfully for PR head `916c190b63635581df14ef43aa7938771a8189b3`, tested as GitHub's PR merge candidate `f823875ea77975e228b4009f2fdc813dddc82379`.

| Layer | Planned | Executed | Passed | Failed / skipped |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| UT | 4,754 | 4,754 | 4,754 | 0 / 0 |
| ST | 24 | 24 | 24 | 0 / 0 |
| Mocked browser E2E (combined four workers) | 101 | 101 | 101 | 0 / 0 |

L1, Coverage and `merge-gate` also passed. The uploaded UT evidence confirms `research test Python: 3.14`, with Biomni 19/19 and DRB 16/16 passing. Real/distribution jobs are outside the PR profile and were not run.

## E2E user journeys

PASS for the normal PR mocked browser plan: 101/101 journeys passed across the literature, research, standard-config and standard-journeys workers, on the merge candidate above with the JiuwenSwarm backend. The research worker accounted for 20/20. This dependency-only change introduces no new product journey; the existing product assertions remain intact.

The actual preparation CLI and offline benchmark pipeline were exercised separately in the target Ubuntu/Python container. No paid model calls, full real-research matrix or gated dataset download were run; ARM64 wheel availability was checked in PyPI metadata, not by executing ARM64. Full product UT/ST/browser E2E layers were not rerun locally; their results above come from GitHub CI.

## Release

Release category: release:fix

User impact: restores research benchmark preparation on the new runner image. No product configuration migration is required.

Desktop SSE `pump` in `apps/desktop` parsed each frame `data:` with bare `JSON.parse`. One malformed frame aborted the stream and dropped the live run UI even when the server kept sending events (#505).

## Harden parse
- Wrap per-frame `JSON.parse` / delivery in try/catch; skip bad frames and count them.
- Keep advancing `lastSequence` when `event` is null so the stream does not stall.
- At stream end, surface at most one `malformedFrames` toast (EN + ZH); clean streams unchanged.
- Wire through `use-workspace` / reducer. No change to tool-output readers (#500).

## Validation (candidate `98612bac`, base `9eb45d75`)
- Scenario / desktop tests: **274/274** (malformed mid-stream, multi-bad one toast, clean-stream regression; new cases fail when product code reverted).
- `pnpm ci:l1`: **4/4** passed.
- `pnpm ci:ut`: 4750/4758; the 8 failures (`executor/ssh-keys`, `workspace` cwd ×2, `runner/scientific-execution` ×2, NPU Broker ×3) are outside `apps/desktop` and match prior box/main noise — not this change. Desktop-related UTs all green.
- `pnpm ci:st`: **24/24** passed.
- **L3 real E2E** (`CI_ALLOW_REAL=1 pnpm ci:e2e:real -- --profile merge --backend legacy`): **9/9** passed (MiniMax `MiniMax-M3` via OpenAI-compat `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1`). Evidence under `.test-runs/e2e-real/`. Mocked L2 left to PR CI.

## Release
Release category: release:fix

520.author: zhaozhaozz
520.body:
On Windows, `serveStatic` compared a resolved path with a hard-coded `/` prefix. `path.resolve` returns backslashes there, so every SPA file and route failed the check and returned `400 Invalid path` before the file was read. The containment check now uses `path.relative` and rejects only a result of `..`, a leading `..` segment in the platform separator, or a result that is still absolute (including another drive or a UNC path).

## Path containment

`services/api/src/http/static.ts` keeps the existing status and body for a rejected path (`400`, `{"error":"Invalid path"}`). MIME types, reading a file inside the static root, falling back to `index.html`, and the built-in page when that file is missing are unchanged. A directory whose name is `..data` stays inside the root and is served. The check does not call `realpath`, so a symlink inside the root is still judged by its lexical path, as before.

## Validation

Focused unit test, from `services/api`:

```sh
node --import tsx --test src/http/static.test.ts
```

Result: tests 8, pass 8, fail 0, skipped 0. Four cases run on the host path implementation and the same four run with Node's `win32` path implementation (`resolve`, `relative`, `isAbsolute`, `extname`, and `sep`). The Windows cases use a backslash static root and map filesystem reads onto real fixture files. They were not run on a Windows machine.

Covered directly:

- `GET /` and `GET /assets/app.js` return 200 with the fixture body under win32 separators.
- `GET /../escape.txt` and `GET /%2e%2e/escape.txt` return 400 with the existing error body, and the file is not read. The same file also rejects the static root's parent, a same-prefix sibling directory, an encoded absolute path, an encoded backslash, another drive, and a UNC path.
- `GET /..data/keep.txt` returns 200. Missing routes still fall back to `index.html`, and a missing index still returns the built-in page.

Full local UT, ST, and E2E were not run. `git diff --check` on the commit is clean. The diff is these two files only.

## E2E user journeys

Not run. The user-visible failure happens when the static root uses Windows separators. On Linux the previous prefix check already returned 200 for files inside the root and 400 for escapes, so a browser, API, or CLI journey on this host cannot show the defect or the fix. No product stack was started. Real Windows and macOS were not used; the win32 half of the unit test is the evidence for that separator.

## Release

Release category: release:fix

User impact: on Windows, the browser UI and other static files load instead of every path returning 400. Rejected paths still return 400 Invalid path.

Compatibility and migration: none.

Fixes #481
520.head: fix/issue-481-windows-static-path
520.title: fix(api): serve SPA static files on Windows instead of returning 400

522.author: ink999107
522.body:
The workbench still rendered the pre-handoff shell: a task list styled by one
sheet, a transcript styled by another, and a composer that carried a 权限模式
control the app does not offer any more. This layer rebuilds the shell around
the handoff's three columns — a 64 px icon rail, the task column and the
conversation — so the layers above it have somewhere to put the panel, 设置 and
the session settings.

**Stack:** part 1 of 5, based on `main`. The next layer is #523.

## The rail and the task column

`Rail` is the new left edge: 任务 and 设置, with the active one marked. It takes
the settings click as a callback rather than owning that state, because the
dialog belongs to `App`.

`Sidebar` is rewritten to the handoff's 科研任务 column: 新建任务, a search field,
the project fold, recent sessions with a relative stamp (`刚刚`, `3 分钟前`,
`2周前`), 显示更多 once the list is longer than six, and the 任务 section that
shows the running task or 暂无任务. `SessionBar` becomes one title row — the
session title, the project crumb, the timestamp and the sidebar/panel toggles —
so the column can be collapsed from where the reader already is.

## The composer's footer

The footer now reads plus, model pill, send. The plus opens the file picker and
states the per-file ceiling and the archive reason in its tooltip; uploading
shows a spinner in place of the glyph so a second pick cannot start. The model
pill names the profile in the interface language and keeps the dropdown above
the input. 权限模式 and the button that opened it are gone from this layer: the
app does not let the user choose an approval mode, and the control promised a
setting that does not exist. The session settings that do exist return in a
later layer.

User turns render as plain grey bubbles, and assistant turns gain copy and
feedback actions under the answer.

## The handoff's palette

`tokens.css` takes the handoff's neutral scale: the old blue-tinted greys give
way to `#191919` text on a flat `#f5f5f5` canvas, the primary to `#1476ff`, and
new `--d-*` tokens name the 64 px rail, 296 px column and 68 px header the
shell is built from. Every older surface reads these tokens, so the retheme
reaches them without editing their rules.

## One stylesheet for the handoff's shell

`design.css` carries the handoff's shell, task column, conversation and
composer. It replaces `redesign.css`, which nothing imported. The older
partials — `shell.css`, `conversation.css`, `composer.css`, `workspace.css` —
still own what the handoff's sheet does not redraw (the context menu, the tool
cards, the transcript's long-answer fold, the structure viewer's chrome), so
they load first and `design.css` wins wherever the two describe the same
element.

## Validation

- `ci:ut` — pending on this head; numbers recorded here before the pull request leaves draft.
- `ci:st` — pending on this head.
- `ci:e2e` — pending on this head.

Desktop typecheck (`tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit`) and the desktop
suite (`npm test -- --run`) also run on this head: 270 tests, 0 failures.

## E2E user journeys

Each journey below is driven in the mocked browser slice by `ci:e2e`.
- **Open a task, collapse the task column** — the rail keeps 任务 selected, the
  conversation takes the space, and the session bar's toggle brings the column
  back.
- **Switch the interface language to English** — rail, task column, composer and
  the new copy all re-render in English, and the choice survives a reload.
- **Upload a file from the composer's plus** — the file lands in the session's
  workspace and the right column opens on it.

## Release

Release category: `release:feature`
User impact: the whole task surface looks and reads differently; the rail,
session list, composer footer and answer actions are new, and 权限模式 is no
longer on the composer.
Labels: this account has no write access to the repository, so the `release:` label below has to be applied by a maintainer.

Compatibility and migration: none — no API, stored setting or data shape
changes; the task column's open/closed state and the interface language keep
their existing keys.

522.title: feat(desktop): rebuild the workbench shell around a task column

523.author: ink999107
523.body:
The right column was a narrow drawer with two stacked sections: a file tree and
an artifact list, sharing a 360 px default width that left no room for a
document beside the tree. The handoff draws it as a wide panel with three group
tabs. This layer makes that shape, and records where a document came from so a
tab cannot surface under the wrong group.

**Stack:** part 2 of 5, built on #522. The next layer is #524.
Compare this layer against the layer below: https://github.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/compare/pr/07-shell...pr/08-workspace-panel

## A wide panel with three groups

`WorkspacePanel` gains a `PanelGroup` union — 团队, 产物, 工作区 — and a group
tab bar above the document area. 团队 states that this build has no
multi-agent team rather than inventing agents; 产物 lists the session's
artifacts; 工作区 is the file tree, with its own search. The document tabs stay
for everything opened inside a group.

The default width moves to 720 px and the bounds to 480–1100 px, with the
conversation's floor at 512 px, because a side column that cannot show a page
beside its tree is not a workspace panel. Later groups still hide on narrow
windows rather than squeezing the conversation.

## A tab remembers where it came from

`preview-tabs` gains a `DocumentSource` (`"artifact" | "file"`) and, for
artifacts, the version id and the display title. `openFile` and `openArtifact`
fill it in, so the 产物 list and the 工作区 tree cannot show each other's
documents. Uploading from the composer lands on 工作区.

## Preview

HTML artifacts render in a sandboxed frame with `srcDoc` — the handoff shows a
generated page as a page — while structure files keep the 3D viewer and
everything else falls back to source. Both new classes are styled in this
layer.

524.author: ink999107
524.body:
设置 was a modal with two tabs and a back/forward history, and most of the
service's own configuration had no surface at all: custom MCP servers, experts,
timeouts and the proxy policy could only be changed in the configuration file.
This layer replaces the dialog with the handoff's full-height settings surface
and fills the panes it needs.

**Stack:** part 3 of 5, built on #523. The next layer is #525.
Compare this layer against the layer below: https://github.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/compare/pr/08-workspace-panel...pr/09-settings

## The surface

`SystemSettingsDialog` is a grouped directory — 系统, 智能, 连接, 工作区 — with
eight panes: 通用, 模型, 技能, MCP 服务器, 专家, 网络, 远程, 超时. It opens over
the task surface, remembers the pane it last showed, and has a footer of 取消并
关闭, 保存 and 保存并关闭. Pages that save immediately say so (这一页的改动即时
保存) instead of showing a save button that would do nothing.

The rail and the composer both open it, and both name the pane they mean —
the model pill's 添加模型 leads to 模型, and 专家 leads to 专家 — instead of
dropping the reader on 通用.

## 模型

One row per profile with its connection test (可用 / the failure message and
latency), 设为主模型, and a delete button drawn but disabled with the reason:
there is no delete route. There is no per-profile edit either — the row does
not offer one, because changing a provider's key is the 添加模型 form with the
same endpoint, which is a different job from editing one row. The add form
lives in a modal and reuses the provider whose base URL it already knows, so a
second visit updates that provider rather than leaving two rows with the key on
one of them.

## MCP 服务器, 专家, 超时

`McpServers` edits custom servers over both transports: command, arguments,
working directory and environment pairs for stdio; URL, headers and an auth
mode (headers or OAuth with client metadata) for HTTP. Secrets are write-only —
a saved value shows 已保存，留空沿用 and is never read back. Test, enable/disable
and delete each report what the server said.

`Specialists` edits the reusable instruction-and-tool sets: name, description,
instructions, runtime (原生 or the external command-line agent), model,
connectors and skills, with delete behind a confirmation that says what stops
working.

`Timeouts` sets the five wall-clock limits, each with an 不限 switch, so a run
that legitimately takes hours is a setting rather than a workaround.

The API surface for these — connectors, global settings, proxy, MCP, web,
memory, IdeaTree and specialists — joins `api/settings.ts` and `api/types.ts`.

## Validation

- `ci:ut` — pending on this head; numbers recorded here before the pull request leaves draft.
- `ci:st` — pending on this head.
- `ci:e2e` — pending on this head.

Desktop typecheck passes and the desktop suite reports 265 tests, 0 failures on
this head. The suite is smaller than the layer below because the old dialog's
navigation tests are replaced by the new surface's pane tests.

## E2E user journeys

Each journey below is driven in the mocked browser slice by `ci:e2e`.
- **Open 设置 from the rail and switch panes** — each pane renders its own
  content, closing and reopening lands on the last pane, and 取消并关闭 discards
  a pending edit.
- **Add a model that cannot be reached** — 测试连接 reports the failure and
  leaves no half-configured provider behind.
- **Register a custom MCP server, save it, reopen it** — the secret shows as
  已保存，留空沿用 and testing reports what the server answered.

## Release

Release category: `release:feature`
User impact: 设置 is a full-height surface with eight panes; MCP servers,
experts and timeouts are configurable from the app for the first time.
Labels: this account has no write access to the repository, so the `release:` label below has to be applied by a maintainer.

Compatibility and migration: none — the configuration file's format and keys
are unchanged; the surface writes the same fields.

525.author: ink999107
525.body:
The previous layer gave 设置 a full-height surface, but the two settings that
belong to one conversation — its approval mode and its experts — had no
composer-level entry point, so changing either meant leaving the task for a
global page. This layer puts them back on the composer, where the handoff draws
them.

**Stack:** part 4 of 5, built on #524. The next layer is #526.
Compare this layer against the layer below: https://github.com/ink999107/sciencediscovery/compare/pr/09-settings...pr/10-composer-settings

## 会话设置

The footer gains a sliders button between 上传 and the model pill. It opens
会话设置: 权限模式 with 请求批准 and 完全访问, each stating what it allows, and
an 专家 row that shows 无 when nothing is assigned and leads to 设置 › 专家 when
clicked.

The mode is the open session's own field. `setApprovalMode` writes it through
`PUT /api/sessions/:id` and reads the reply back into the detail, so a refused
write cannot leave the menu claiming a mode the session does not have. With no
session open it does nothing, because there is nothing to write: the choice
applies to a session that exists, and a draft inherits the server's default.

## Locked while a run is in flight

Both entries are disabled while a run is in flight. The mode decides how the
run's approvals are handled, so changing it mid-run would apply to something
already running. The disabled button says so in its tooltip instead of
disappearing, which is the same rule the model pill follows.

## Validation

- `ci:st` — pending on this head.
- `ci:e2e` — pending on this head.

- **Start a run, then open 会话设置** — both entries are disabled and say why.
- **Open 会话设置 with no session** — the menu renders with 无 for 专家 and no
  write is attempted.

## Release

User impact: the approval mode and the assigned experts are reachable from the
composer again, and the mode is honest about what the session actually has.

527.author: ink999107
527.body:
A provider configured in 设置 could not be verified: pressing 测试连接 answered
"Request body must be valid JSON" instead of a connectivity result. The service
`POST /api/models/:id/test` requires a consent flag in its body, and the
desktop's client sent no body at all, so every check failed before it reached
the provider.

## The fix

`testModel` sends `{ compatibility, consent: true }`, and takes the
`compatibility` flag from its caller instead of hard-coding it. Both callers — the compatibility
probe from the wizard and the plain check from 设置 — now share one body
shape.

## Validation

- `ci:ut` — pending on this head; numbers recorded here before the pull request leaves draft.
- `ci:st` — pending on this head.
- `ci:e2e` — pending on this head.

Desktop typecheck passes and the desktop suite reports 271 tests, 0 failures on
this head. The new api-client test asserts both bodies — `{ compatibility:
false, consent: true }` and `{ compatibility: true, consent: true }` — because
the failure was a missing field, not a wrong URL.

Verified against a live custom provider from the wizard: the check returns
`category: "ok"` with provider status 200 instead of the 400 "valid JSON" error.

## E2E user journeys

Each journey below is driven in the mocked browser slice by `ci:e2e`.
- **Configure a custom provider, then press 测试连接 in 设置** — the row reports
  可用 with a latency instead of a 400.

## Release

Release category: `release:fix`
User impact: custom model providers configured in the app can be tested again;
before this, the button always failed.
Labels: this account has no write access to the repository, so the `release:` label below has to be applied by a maintainer.

Compatibility and migration: none.

528.author: ink999107
528.body:
The single-PR skill covers one change end to end, but this project proposes
larger changes as a stack of layers, and the rules that make a stack work were
spread across the session that built one. This adds them as a skill so the next
stack starts from the same procedure.

**Independent of the other pull requests in this batch.**

## What the skill covers

- The shape: one branch per layer cut from the layer below, one capability per
  layer, and no layer referencing a symbol that only exists above it.
- The body's stack section, so a reviewer knows which diff to read and in what
  order the pull requests merge.
- Rebase-merge rather than squash, because a squash collapses two layers into
  one commit and the next branch loses the parent it was built on.
- The push-through-the-Git-Data-API path for when `github.com` is unreachable
  for git transport, including the check that every server-side blob, tree and
  commit SHA matches the local one.
- What to do after a lower layer merges: reconstruct the rewritten commit,
  rebase the next layer onto it, verify the diff is still the layer's own, and
  push again.
- Review threads on lower layers: out of scope for the upper pull request, and
  answered rather than quietly resolved.

The single-PR skill gains a link to it.
